data.name: Tandem Kayak
data.headline: 1-8 Hour options • Ages 18+ to rent
data.description: Our 2 person kayaks are a great way to experience the bay and get in a little exercise. It’s great for kids and there’s a lot to see and do around the bay. All our rentals come with lifejackets and our staff can point you in the right direction to go to see some sites and experience the bay.
data.highlights:
-Life vests included
-All vessels are required to stay within the bay
